description: This file is a shell script for testing git clone directory naming conventions and URL parsing logic. It contains setup functions, various test cases, and assertions to verify correct behavior of git clone URL handling, especially around SSH URLs, relative paths, and authentication info redaction.

methods.name: test_clone_dir
methods.description: Defines a function to test cloning a repository from a URL into a specified directory with options for bare or non-bare clones. Performs setup, execution, and assertion for each test case.
